name: fz-panel-dev
js: const p = document.getElementById('panel'); p.classList.remove('hidden'); const s = document.getElementById('dev-section'); s.hidden = false; s.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); const r = s.getBoundingClientRect(); return { sectionH: Math.round(r.height), panelScrollH: p.scrollHeight, outs: ['focus-mag-out', 'focus-ms-out', 'focus-vignette-out'].map((id) => document.getElementById(id).textContent) };
